global_events: Asian equities are higher for a second straight day, helped by China's industrial profits jumping 20.1% year on year in October, a 5-month high. Crude is firm, with Brent near its monthly high on Middle East supply worries, while the dollar sits close to a 22-month peak amid lingering AI-related jitters. Gold is steady and on track for a weekly gain. Despite the upbeat Asian tone, GIFT Nifty points to a soft open for Indian indices.
central_banks: US PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, rose to 3.8% in October, which raises the stakes for the Fed in 2027, and markets are watching for policy signals. Pablo Hernández de Cos of Spain is reportedly set to lead the European Central Bank. Commentary suggests the incoming Fed chair, Warsh, may need to lean hawkish.
policy_sentiment: The Supreme Court has asked HDFC Bank and three other lenders to approve the prosecution of their staff, a governance headline for banks. Falling gold prices are also raising questions about risks to India's ₹23 lakh crore gold loan market.

research.why: Nature Nanotechnology demonstration of a hybrid core pairing VO2 Mott leaky integrate-and-fire neurons with domain-wall racetrack memory for event-driven spiking networks, linking spintronic memory to neuromorphic computing.
research.title: Integration of Mott neurons and spintronic memories for event-driven spiking neural networks

research.why: Nature paper showing coherent time-resolved parity oscillations in two coupled minimal Kitaev chains with four poor man's Majoranas, a step toward topologically protected qubits.
research.title: Coherent parity oscillations in coupled minimal Kitaev chains

research.why: Nature Physics demonstration of two-qubit gates between interacting electron qubits on solid neon, advancing a new high-coherence qubit platform.
research.title: Coherent manipulation of interacting electron qubits on solid neon

research.why: PRL protocol for high-purity spin entanglement through a magnon bus that avoids the usual fidelity-versus-decay trade-off by coupling magnons only to a transition outside the computational basis.
research.title: High-Purity Entanglement Mediated by Magnons Despite Weak Coupling

research.why: PRL identifies a Rashba-type interfacial spin-lattice coupling that yields kineoelasticity and nonreciprocal phonons, relevant to magnon-phonon hybrid devices.
research.title: Kineoelasticity and Nonreciprocal Phonons by Rashba-Induced Interfacial Spin-Lattice Coupling

research.why: PRL reports giant room-temperature magnetoelectric coupling in nanocomposite thin films via strain-sensitive polarization, relevant to electric-field control of magnetism.
research.title: Giant Room-Temperature Magnetoelectric Coupling Effect in Nanocomposite Thin Films via Strain-Sensitive Polarization

research.why: Preprint showing mode-resolved spin-wave (FMR) spectroscopy with a single NV center via the magnon Kerr effect, a nanoscale magnon-sensing tool.
research.title: Mode-resolved spin-wave spectroscopy by a single paramagnetic center

research.why: Nature Machine Intelligence perspective on self-driving laboratories, arguing LLM hypothesis generation must be combined with reward-driven optimization and executable workflows, with relevance to autonomous materials and magnetics research.
research.title: Enabling lab autonomy with reward functions and executable workflows
